officialText:
An application for authorization for temporary residence pursuant to section 28-507.4 must be accompanied by a certification from the owner of an eligible basement or cellar residence indicating whether such residence was rented to a tenant on April 20, 2024, notwithstanding whether the occupancy of such residence was authorized by law. Such certification may not be used as the basis for an enforcement action for the illegal occupancy of such unit, provided however that nothing in this article shall prevent the issuance of a vacate order for imminently hazardous or unsafe conditions.

(L.L. 2024/126, 12/18/2024, eff. 6/16/2025)
